entries.zh: 瞭望哨船；担任瞭望警戒之船（centinela＝哨兵）
entries.en: sentinel ship; lookout/watch vessel

entries.zh: 载给养之船、粮船；艚类小船〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: ship for carrying provisions; small cargo boat [source damaged, gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: 西语词头 pa[残] 段不足读，汉字第二字有[疑]（艚较合音注 chē），据残存 sustento（给养）推断为载给养之船，故列低置信。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕似指小舟一类（西语残缺不足读，汉字作'舢？山'）
entries.en: some kind of small boat/vessel [source damaged, gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: 西语 nauaja fum[残]iera 不足读（'ż'盖为 que），汉字'舢'有[疑]、M 栏第二调号 T99 污损，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 甲板船；卡斯蒂利亚大帆船（马尼拉称来自卡斯蒂利亚的大帆船）
entries.en: decked ship; the Castilian galleon (ship from Castile in the Manila trade)
entries.notes: 西语 de Castilla（卡斯蒂利亚船）与'甲板舡'之对应为马尼拉语境等值：西式大帆船有甲板，华人遂以'甲板船'称之。

entries.zh: 小舵之船；汉字作'牵风舡'（字面谓牵风行驶之小船）
entries.en: ship with a small rudder; small boat ('wind-drawing vessel' in the Chinese gloss)
entries.notes: 西语 de timón pequeño（舵小）与汉字'牵风舡'对应关系不直观，释义自两侧字面分列，一致性待考。

entries.zh: 小船；鸟船（小型船只）
entries.en: small ship; 'bird boat' (type of small vessel)

entries.zh: 小船；舟楫（泛指舟船）
entries.en: small ship; boats and oars; vessels generally

entries.zh: 好使的船；行驶便利、易于操驾之船（西语谓操驾良好）
entries.en: a ship that handles well; vessel of good governance/steering

entries.zh: 大载量之船；舱深船大（西语谓载货量大）
entries.en: ship of great burden/carrying capacity; deep-hulled vessel

entries.zh: 操驾不善之船、难使唤之船（西语 mal gobierno）
entries.en: ship of bad governance; ill-handled or unmanageable vessel
entries.notes: 西语 de mal gobierno（操驾不善）与汉字'舡艦'字面不相应，对应关系存疑，释义以西语侧为准。

entries.zh: 搁浅之船（西语谓船撞上干处、搁于浅滩）
entries.en: ship that runs aground; vessel that strikes the shallows/dry ground
entries.notes: 'ż'当读 que（参本页第12条用法），da en seco 谓搁浅；汉字第二字有[疑]且与音注不尽合，释义以西语短语为主。

entries.zh: 巡哨船；沿岸巡防警戒之船
entries.en: coast-guard ship; patrol vessel keeping/guarding the coast

entries.zh: 教堂中殿；教堂正厅
entries.en: nave of a church; church nave
entries.notes: 汉字'接靂'第二字有[疑]且与音注 huy 不合，'教堂中殿'系据西语 naue de yglesia 推定。

entries.zh: 驾船；驾驭行舟
entries.en: to sail; to pilot or steer (a boat)

entries.zh: 行船漂海（汉字栏仅'使'字，音注连读作'使漂海'）
entries.en: to sail; to drift out on the sea
entries.notes: 汉字栏仅'使'一字而音注三音节，参照本页第16条（漂海＝piō hai／piā̃ hāi）推断为'使漂海'。

entries.zh: 漂海；漂洋于海
entries.en: to drift on the sea; to sail

entries.zh: 行海；行船渡海
entries.en: to sail the sea; to travel/go by sea

entries.zh: 使船；驾船操舟
entries.en: to pilot or work a ship; to steer a vessel

entries.zh: 放船出海；船启航开出
entries.en: to set a boat off; for the ship to sail out/depart

entries.zh: 使帆；扬帆启航
entries.en: to make sail; to hoist the sail and set out
entries.notes: 音注混入西语 ta vela，且 hoā̃ iā̃ 两音节无对应汉字，释义据西语 salir（船出发）与汉字'使帆'推断。

entries.zh: 逆水行船；逆流行舟
entries.en: to sail against the current
entries.notes: 汉字首字有[疑:逆/送]，音注 gieh 合'逆'而不合'送'，四栏语义清晰，唯依体例（有[疑]）列中置信。

entries.zh: 顺水行船；顺流而行
entries.en: to sail with the current; to follow the current
entries.notes: 汉字栏为[空]，'顺水行船'据西语 tras la corriente 与音注 sun chui heng chūn（顺水行船）推定。
